author: mark
text:
Alignment audit findings (in_progress; will close after notes land):

Verified ✓
- §2.2/§2.3/§2.10/§3.5/§4.4/§5 are mutually consistent on the v0.3.1 contract:
  step records at <conv-repo>/steps/<conv-id>/<NNN>/, outside every worktree;
  diagnostic-only contract on request.json/response.json; tool input/output.json
  exempt; step 1 commits goal+soul, step ≥2 has no pre-call commit; meta.json
  carries the read-state commit sha; response.json is JSONL of §4.4 events in
  both modes; writer-closes-fd is the §3.5 IN_CLOSE_WRITE completion signal;
  manifest.yaml worker.order MUST NOT reference steps/**.
- PRINCIPLES.md: 'Read state per step is a real git commit', 'Single source of
  truth' (assembler-from-commit replaces request.json mirror; per-call
  output.json is sole source for tool output), 'File path as hint' explicit
  step-records exception — all three are consistent with the §2.x amendments.
- template/manifest.yaml worker.order: no steps/** entries (§5.2 satisfied).
- src/ harness: zero runtime reads of REQUEST_FILE/RESPONSE_FILE; all read
  sites under src/prompt/tests/ are diagnostic-asserting tests, not harness
  state. (§2.3 'no harness code site reads request.json or response.json at
  runtime' satisfied structurally and by absence.)
- Scratch lernie new lays manifest.yaml/providers.yaml/version/souls/root/ at
  conv-repo root; src/prompt/dispatch/step_commit.rs writes step records to
  conv_repo.join('steps/<conv-id>/<NNN>/...'), confirming layout.
- UI fs_watcher (crates/lernie-ui-egui/src/fs_watcher/mod.rs:28-35) treats
  steps/ as a conv-repo-root prefix (not per-worktree); git_tree detect.rs
  uses branch-name conversation detection, not steps/** path diff. P4 landed
  the UI cutover correctly.

Drift flagged
- ARCH §2.2 narrative imprecision (line 94): 'Per-tool output.json is the
  one runtime read in this tree (§3.3)'. §2.3 (line 151) acknowledges
  input.json is also read at replay time. Tightening inline as part of the
  audit (1-line edit), so that §2.2 and §2.3 read the same way about which
  per-tool files are runtime-read and when.
- README docs drift surfaced during alignment audit; logged on the docs gate
  bl-0c2e since that gate's scope explicitly covers README.
